title: Foundries See Growth, New Issues In 2019

passages.note: Leading-edge race, TSMC and Samsung 7 nm production paragraphs. Contemporary technical reporting identifies that TSMC used 193 nm immersion and multiple patterning when it moved into production on the initial 7 nm version in 2018. The account distinguishes the subsequent planned EUV version.

lineage: Technical trade reporting published independently of the foundry. The production-method sentence is the reporter’s account and is not presented as an independent measurement.
